positive.point: Gary Payton II (GP2) is playing the second-best stretch of his career, with improved shooting, passing, and playmaking, making him a more rounded and valuable player offensively.
Gui Santos is seen as having the highest upside among younger players, with elite court awareness and a playing style reminiscent of Jimmy Butler.
Santos made a pivotal steal and stepped up significantly in the second half, contributing to a game win.

negative.point: Gary Payton II is not the same defensive force he once was, having been considered one of the best guard defenders in the league.
